prompt: A designer vinyl toy playset: glossy, smooth molded plastic in soft candy colors, rounded chunky shapes and cute collectible figures with oversized heads, arranged on a rounded display base. At the center, two simple seated figures in casual morning clothes relax on a red-striped picnic blanket with a halved foil-wrapped burrito between them. Just in front, a scruffy tan dog happily guards an oversized bright neon-yellow tennis ball between his front paws. Two tall palm trees stand at the back right corner, while far in the background a tiny plastic disc hovers near distant tiny park-goers under clear morning light. Premium collectible product shot with soft highlights and no harsh reflections. The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Plain seamless soft neutral background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
